name: gonogo
description: Pressure-test a startup idea in a live voice interview with Alex, then get a GO / NO-GO verdict.

interface.longDescription:
GoNoGo validates startup and business ideas: a live voice interview with an AI startup mentor, market research, and a GO or NO-GO verdict on whether the idea is worth building.

Ask ChatGPT to pressure-test your idea and Alex, GoNoGo's AI startup mentor, appears right in the chat as a live talking video. Press Start and talk to him out loud. Alex asks the questions founders tend to skip: who exactly has this problem, what they do about it today, who would pay and why now. Progress bars under the video show which parts of the idea he has covered: founder, problem, solution and market. The interview takes about 15 minutes, and you can go full screen to keep the chat beside you.

When Alex has what he needs, GoNoGo researches the market behind your answers and gives a GO or NO-GO verdict with a score and the reasons. Ask ChatGPT for the result of any of your projects, or open the full reports on gonogo.team.

What you can do:
- Run a live voice interview with Alex about your idea, in the language of your chat
- See your GoNoGo projects and whether their research is still running
- Get the verdict and score of a project right in the conversation

GoNoGo works with your GoNoGo account: you connect it once, and your interviews and projects are saved there. Your voice is used only to run the conversation and is not recorded.
defaultPrompt: Pressure-test my startup idea with Alex
Is my business idea worth building? Interview me
Show my GoNoGo projects and their verdicts
